title: The Whisper Man
plot_overview: When his young son disappears, a widowed father turns to his estranged, retired detective father for help. The search draws them back to an old serial killer case, as investigators try to understand how it may be connected to the boy’s disappearance.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like serial-killer mysteries with family tension and a suspenseful search; Not for you if you want a fresh premise or a consistently focused tone.
review_summary: Pros: capable performances; suspenseful premise; strong supporting cast | Cons: familiar thriller beats; predictable plot; uncertain tone
